# d-stellar

> LGBTQ+-friendly cookie shop and trans safe space in Hipódromo Condesa, Mexico City. Gourmet author-style cookies ("galletas de autor") with a menu that rotates every month, plus signature coffee/drinks and community events, founded 2024 by Hernán Castilla and Eduardo Hernández ("The Sweet Universe Company").

d-stellar sells gourmet cookies and signature coffee/drinks from a single
physical location at Av. Nuevo León 217, Hipódromo Condesa, Cuauhtémoc,
06100, Ciudad de México (inside Pabellón Nuevo León, shared hallway
entrance). The full menu — cookies, signature drinks, and a caffeine-free
section — rotates every month. d-stellar also hosts community events (drag
viewing parties, book presentations, cookie tastings) and rents its space
for private events. As of October 2026, d-stellar has a 5.0-star average
rating from 156 Google reviews.

d-stellar positions itself explicitly as a trans safe space and an
LGBTQ+-friendly business — this is core to the brand identity, not a
marketing campaign. Hours: Mon/Thu/Sat/Sun 11:00–19:00, Tue 14:00–19:00,
Wed/Fri 12:00–19:00. Contact is WhatsApp only (no in-store cell signal for
calls). Note: d-stellar.com is an old, unrelated legacy store — the real
site is the .co domain.

## Key pages

- [Home (Spanish, default)](https://www.d-stellar.co/): overview, hours, location, current monthly menu highlights
- [Home (English)](https://www.d-stellar.co/en): English version of the homepage
- [Menu](https://www.d-stellar.co/menu): full current cookie, drink, and caffeine-free menu, updated monthly
- [FAQ](https://www.d-stellar.co/faq): location, hours, parking, transit, pickup process, vegan options, events
- [Visit](https://www.d-stellar.co/visit): directions, address, hours, amenities, embedded map
- [About](https://www.d-stellar.co/about): brand story, founders, values
- [Pickup](https://www.d-stellar.co/pickup): how to order ahead for pickup (no delivery offered)
- [Events](https://www.d-stellar.co/events): community events and private event rental
- [Press](https://www.d-stellar.co/press): verified press coverage naming d-stellar by name
- [Historias](https://www.d-stellar.co/historias): monthly menu collection stories/archive
